definitions.explanation: The area of the body below the navel. Used in medical, health, and everyday contexts to refer to this specific part of the torso.

examples.japanese: {下腹|したばら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
{下腹|したばら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧きた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦ダイエット→ダイエット：17678_daietto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: My lower belly started sticking out, so I started a diet.

examples.japanese: {下腹|したばら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{締|し}める→引き締める：15264_hikishimeru⟧⟦エクササイズ→エクササイズ：29745_ekusasaizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I've been doing exercises to tighten my lower abdomen every day.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧ (lower) + {腹|ばら} (belly/abdomen). The reading ⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧ばら uses rendaku (sequential voicing) on ⟦{腹|はら}→腹：02165_hara⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {下腹|したばら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧: lower abdomen hurts
- {下腹|したばら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: lower belly protrudes
- {下腹|したばら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{締|し}める→引き締める：15264_hikishimeru⟧: to tighten the lower abdomen
- {下腹|したばら}{部|ぶ}: lower abdominal area (medical)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {下腹部|かふくぶ}: lower abdomen — the medical/formal equivalent; read with on'yomi
- ⟦{腹|はら}→腹：02165_hara⟧/⟦お{腹|なか}→お腹：00805_onaka⟧: belly/stomach — the whole abdomen, not specifically the lower part
- {上腹|うわばら}/{上腹部|じょうふくぶ}: upper abdomen — the area above the navel
